name: Fleet Hub
prompt:
"Design an 'Autonomous Delivery Fleet Hub' app. The system must process a streaming-style API dataset containing: Drone ID, Battery %, Payload Weight, Target Destination, and Route Exception Flag (True/False).

The UI must feature:

An interactive telemetry grid tracking active vehicles.

A text input box called 'Command Prompt'. If the user types 'Recall low battery vehicles', the app must instantly filter the view to show only entries with Battery % < 20 and trigger a red warning animation on those specific rows.

A dynamic 'SLA Countdown Timer' column that ticks down in real-time seconds for each drone's remaining delivery window."

thought_process.interpretation: I have designed this as a 'Process Monitor' application for an Operations Manager persona. The focus is on real-time situational awareness (telemetry) and rapid command execution (Recall Command). The visual style adheres strictly to the provided hex-token specifications, emphasizing a high-contrast dark-mode default while supporting light-mode transitions. The 'streaming' nature is simulated via state-managed intervals for the SLA timers and battery depletion.
assumed_from_scratch: Real-time countdown logic using React hooks
Command-parser logic for natural language trigger
Tailwind-based row animation for warning states
thought_process.skill_suggestions: A 'real_time_streaming.md' skill could be useful to standardize how agents mock tick-based data updates and countdowns.
